workload_workday_length_002.evidence: Every good faith effort will be made to schedule all IEP and IFSP conferences during the seven-hour workday.

workload_prep_guarantee_003.evidence: 7.2.8.1.1 ... shall have a duty-free preparation period ... 7.2.8.1.3 ... shall have one hundred ninety (190) minutes of duty free preparation time

workload_prep_minutes_004.answer: Secondary: equal in length to a teaching period, plus an additional 30 minutes/week; TK-5: 190 minutes/week (blocks ≥20 min); Central Support: 45 minutes/day

workload_prep_protected_005.evidence: Unit members in Support Services shall not be required to schedule services during their preparation time.

workload_lunch_duty_free_006.evidence: Teachers shall be provided a duty-free lunch period, equivalent in length to the lunch period of the teachers’ students, exclusive of passing periods, or thirty (30) consecutive minutes, whichever is longer.
